CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.TITLE: Knowledge
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.DESCRIPTION: Add webpages and files to one knowledge base used by your AI.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.FILE_SUPPORT: Supported: PDF and DOCX, maximum 50 MB
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.FILE_QUEUED: File uploaded and queued for parsing.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.FILE_REUSED: This identical file was already parsed and has been reused.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.FILE_ALREADY_PROCESSING: This identical file is already being processed.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.FILE_REUSE_DISABLED: This identical file already exists but is disabled. Enable it to include it in the next version.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.FILE_REUSE_RETRY: This identical file already exists but its parse needs to be retried.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.AUTHORITY_UPDATED: Knowledge authority updated for future versions.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.ADDITIVE_NOTE: Adding a file keeps every existing material. Select Update knowledge after changing sources.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.NO_CTA_LINKS: No contextual CTA links were extracted.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.NO_MATERIALS: Add a website or upload a file to begin.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.UPDATE_QUEUED: The combined knowledge base is being updated.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.DELETE_CONFIRM: Remove this material from the AI knowledge base? The current knowledge stays live until the updated index is ready.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.DELETE_QUEUED: The material change is being applied to the knowledge base.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.BUILD_QUEUED: A new combined knowledge version is being built.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.VERSION_NOTE: Publishing switches one immutable version; it does not mutate earlier versions.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.ROLLED_BACK: The previous knowledge version was restored.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.EVALUATION_NOTE: Run the held-out retrieval suite before publishing. It must contain at least five supported and five negative cases across all required categories.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.EVALUATION_PLACEHOLDER: Paste a JSON array containing query, category, expectation, expected_sources and expected_text.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.EVALUATION_JSON_ERROR: Evaluation cases must be a valid JSON array.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.QUESTION: Question
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.PURGE_CONFIRM: Permanently remove this disabled upload and its private stored file? Published knowledge is not changed.
CHATRING_KNOWLEDGE.PURGED: The disabled upload and its private stored file were permanently removed.
